Eco-Flex in the field

Protect the bank. Make room for vegetation.

Eco-Flex is designed for sites where erosion protection and revegetation need to work together. This proof section is reserved for a verified project pair showing both the original field condition and the completed application after vegetation begins to establish.

Show the engineered system and the recovering site.

How Eco-Flex works

Reinforce the bank and leave space for vegetation.

Eco-Flex uses a project-specific fabric form that creates grout-filled protection with open cells distributed across the mat. Those openings provide space for soil and vegetation while the articulated system reinforces the protected area.

The design must balance slope protection, vegetation and the environmental goals of the project. Eco-Flex is selected where the field conditions support a vegetated solution rather than continuous coverage.

  1. Evaluate the Site

    Document velocity, duration of flow, slope, soils, vegetation goals and regulatory requirements.

  2. Design the Layout

    Configure the protected limits, open-cell treatment, anchoring and transitions.

  3. Fabricate and Install

    Sew the site-specific mat, place it on the prepared area and fill the system with grout.

  4. Revegetate and Establish

    Complete soil and vegetation treatment within the open cells and monitor establishment as needed.

Why open cells matter

Performance and recovery can work together.

Supports Revegetation

Open areas allow roots and stems to establish within the protected surface.

Reduces Visual Impact

Vegetation can soften the appearance of the completed stabilization work.

Meets Site Objectives

The system can support environmental and permitting requirements where conditions allow.

Works as Part of a System

Eco-Flex can be paired with stronger bed protection where banks and channel bottoms require different treatments.
